label: Peplink Balance 380X
description: Wireless-broadband SD-WAN router: 3x GE WAN, 3x GE LAN, 3 Gbps routing throughput.
notes: Vendor figures from the Peplink tech-spec sheet: Ethernet WAN port 3 (GE), Number of Ethernet LAN port 3 (GE), Router Throughput **3 Gbps**, Wi-Fi AP No, PoE Input No, SFP LAN/WAN No. Despite the 'Wireless Broadband' name the sheet says **Wi-Fi AP No** - the wireless in the name refers to what it aggregates, not to a radio inside the box.
